title: First scat singing
summary: He credits Louis Armstrong with starting scat singing, though people hummed melodies at home earlier.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: When did you first hear anybody doing any scat singing?
Scat singing with Lorenzo Armstrong. He started it.

I mean, to be truthful about it, I don't know. I don't remember. I remember people at their homes, I mean, like I was telling you about them people, ta-la-la-la, you know, you know what I mean, singing in the kitchen, you know, dancing, you know. You know, they'd sing them songs, you know, but they wouldn't be singing no words or nothing, but they'd be humming a melody, you know.
